fixes.change: Replace all three StartTimerBJ calls and both GetLastCreatedTimerBJ uses with TimerStart and explicitly owned handles.
fixes.mechanism: StartTimerBJ overwrites Blizzard's root-created bj_lastStartedTimer, making that original handle eligible for garbage collection. A published minimal Lua repro identifies this pattern.
fixes.evidence_limit: The cited author reproduced LAN failures but not the two Battle.net trials. Current-game incident was not reproduced.

fixes.change: Move 4 timer, 6 group and 7 hashtable allocations to ordered idempotent FE_InitNativeGlobals before existing library initializers.
fixes.mechanism: Avoid native-object creation before native map initialization. Existing global references and relative library/trigger initialization order are retained.
fixes.evidence_limit: Preventive hardening; these seventeen allocations are not proven to have caused a client mismatch.

fixes.change: Retain all four perpetual timers in owning modules; prevent duplicate Cultist initialization.
fixes.mechanism: No Lua reference previously retained these handles after initialization. Explicit ownership removes dependency on native wrapper retention and client-specific garbage collection timing.
fixes.evidence_limit: Weak-native forced-GC double proves Lua ownership and continued callbacks, not current Warcraft garbage-collection behavior.

fixes.change: Private strong ownership for pending Freeze Zone dummy-cast timers; release after expiry, with unchanged target/hashtable cleanup.
fixes.evidence_limit: Forced-GC test validates Lua reachability; cannot explain pre-Lua incidents.

fixes.change: FE_Timers owns legacy timer wrappers until explicit native destruction. Nine modules mechanically replace 34 create/destroy calls; callback timing, expiry, rearm, native hashtable and cancellation logic remain unchanged.
fixes.identified_exposure: 13 transient creation sites lacked demonstrated strong Lua ownership; additional already-global timers in those modules use the same helpers consistently.
fixes.evidence_limit: Defensive lifetime correction, not thirteen proven desync causes. Frozen r10 comparison proves other callback bodies unchanged, except separately tested Cosmic Strike correction.

fixes.change: Mana refund reads the captured caster instead of native GetEventDamageSource from an unrelated/synthetic damage context.
fixes.evidence_limit: Confirmed gameplay/context bug; not established as a desync cause.

fixes.change: Set half-damage interval Hfs4 from zero to 1.0 while retaining zero half damage. Guard every authored Flame Strike interval and all Lightning/Sand levels.
fixes.evidence_limit: Matches an independently reported freeze pattern. This old Arcane Strike definition has no active unit/script assignment found, so it is not evidence for the reported incident.

reviewed_without_demonstrated_divergence: Eight GetLocalPlayer paths only affect presentation or local preload I/O. Feed settings are applied by synchronized receive handlers.
Shop buyer updates use synchronized selection events; no local IsUnitSelected query drives purchases.
No active pairs traversal, local clock/I/O/random path or gameplay branch using camera/selection state was found.
Bloodmage terrain Z affects lightning graphics only. Passive missile Z affects effects/sound; XY controls damage timing.
Cultist/Ice/Light state updates use ordered traversal. Native hashtable IDs are lookup keys, not cross-client messages or iteration order.
Solo eligibility is captured at startup, never re-enabled by multiplayer departures; takeover and role mutation use synchronized events.
independent_review: A separate reviewer checked all17 allocation identities/order, eager aliases, first consumers, timer arguments/cadence and idempotence; no introduced lifecycle/order issue found. The second integration review confirmed all nine transient-timer migrations, no local ownership mutations, no uncovered active unowned timers, and unchanged expiry/rearm/cancellation behavior.
